semantic_gaps: Master Calendar: one row per month (36) as in QlikView; Month and Year - Month are labels sorted by hidden Month__num / Year - Month__num columns (QlikView duals).

Null-key 'Unknown' members the script adds for null fact keys (Carrier Groups, Carrier Operating Region, Origin / Destination Markets) are not loaded: they associate with nothing in QlikView and would wrongly match blank keys in Power BI. Dimension row counts are therefore one lower than QlikView's where [Main Data] has null keys; measures are unaffected.
Aircraft Types: empty CSV fields are null in Power BI (QlikView stores an empty string, e.g. the manufacturer of aircraft type 91); ApplyMap's default 'Unknown' applies to both.
COMMENT TABLES / FIELDS USING Comments.xls -> TMDL descriptions on the table and on every column of that name (QlikView comments a field in every table).
STORE [Aircraft Types] INTO 'Aircraft Types Transformed.qvd' is an ETL side effect and is not migrated; IF $(vLoadMainData) = 'Y' always loads.
Calculated dimension (Flight Type deal status, Funnel Chart CH27) -> calculated column on Flight Types.
Drill-down group Time (Year > Month) and cyclic group Airline_Origin_Destination -> parity at every level; in the report as a Year > Month hierarchy and separate visuals.

List boxes -> slicers on the page of their sheet (field = the list box caption decoded from the .qvw): the linked list boxes of the chart sheets (Year, Quarter, Month, Flight Type, Carrier Group, Carrier's Operating Region, Carrier Name) are a dropdown slicer column on each chart page; Associations and Data Consistency get their own pages. LB10 'Aircraft Type' and LB11 'Aircraft Group' are not migrated: Chapter 9's script loads no such fields (the list boxes are empty in the .qvw too). Carrier Group slicers lack QlikView's 'Unknown' value, which only the null-key member carries (see above), so LB15/LB29 have no parity check.

QlikView-only objects (multi boxes MB01/MB02, search object, buttons, bookmark object, current selections, container, statistics box SB01, table box TB01, text objects) are not migrated; gauge styles (CH07-CH14) are one gauge. Only native visuals are used: the Radar Chart (CH24) is a line chart, the Grid Chart (CH26) a matrix and the Mekko Chart (CH25) a 100% stacked column chart.
